runtime_note: The predicate LOGIC is fully static and exhaustively solved by z3 over the complete enum domain {posix, nt}. However os.name is a runtime OS probe set by the interpreter at import time from the live platform; it is NOT reachable from CLI/YAML/public input. A caller cannot drive this branch either way without changing the host OS (or monkeypatching os.name). Hence classification=runtime-dependent: the witnesses are real z3 models but the actual taken branch is environment-determined, not solver-chosen. On the char-test CI host (posix) the guard ALWAYS raises ValueError; the function body (PATHEXT split) is unreachable on posix.
